papers.title: BRF-GS: Hyperspectral Bidirectional Reflectance Factor Modeling and Image Generation Based on 3D Gaussian Splatting
papers.authors: Yiling Yao, Wenjuan Zhang, Bowen Wang, Bocheng Li, Wentao Song, Bing Zhang
papers.tags: 3D reconstruction, image generation, diffusion model, scene understanding
papers.affiliations: Aerospace Information Research Institute, Chinese Academy of Sciences; International Research Center of Big Data for Sustainable Development Goals; University of Chinese Academy of Sciences
papers.intro: 本文提出BRF-GS，一种基于3D高斯泼溅的框架，通过引入混合BRDF驱动核表示、几何可靠波段选择和几何-光谱解耦的两阶段训练策略，实现遥感场景中高光谱双向反射因子建模和多角度反射率图像的高效生成。

papers.title: VeriCam: A Verification Baseline for the Classification of Unknown Data
papers.authors: Lucas Wojcik, Gabriel E. Lima, Sergio M. Silva, Eduil Nascimento, David Menotti
papers.tags: image classification, vision transformer, image retrieval, edge deployment
papers.affiliations: Federal University of Paraná（巴拉那联邦大学）；Paraná Military Police（巴拉那州军事警察）
papers.intro: VeriCam提出了一种基于验证网络（verification network）的零样本分类流水线，通过训练模型判别图像对是否属于同一类别来构建关系图，再利用图聚类算法实现对未知类别的动态识别，并在LPLCv2交通监控数据集上验证了其有效性。

papers.title: DreamX-Creator: Democratizing Native Audio-Video Generation at 2K Resolution
papers.authors: Jiashu Zhu, Yanhao Zheng, Ruitian Tian, Rujing Dang, Shen Zhang, Bingze Song, Jiachen Lei, Ruimin Lin, Jiahong Wu, Xiangxiang Chu
papers.tags: video generation, diffusion model, multimodal learning
papers.affiliations: DreamX Team, Alibaba Group
papers.intro: DreamX-Creator 1.0 是一个以7B参数生成器为核心的紧凑型原生联合音视频生成系统，通过门控跨模态注意力、渐进式联合训练、音视频强化学习和自回归1步2K细化流水线，实现了与最先进开源系统竞争性能的原生同步音视频生成，并开源了模型权重。

papers.title: Real-Time Video Anomaly Detection Using YOLO Pose Estimation and CLIP-Based Semantic Scoring
papers.authors: Vanodhya G. Warnasooriya, Amir Hajian, Watchara Ruangsang, Supavadee Aramvith
papers.tags: pose estimation, CLIP, YOLO, video segmentation
papers.affiliations: Chulalongkorn University, King Mongkut's Univ. of Technology Thonburi
papers.intro: 本文提出一个轻量级两阶段视频异常检测框架，利用YOLO v11n-pose进行人员检测与姿态估计，再通过CLIP ViT-B/32对裁剪的人员区域进行文本-图像语义相似度评分，以直接余弦相似度替代多特征密度估计，在保持可比精度的同时实现3.36倍吞吐量提升（51.39 FPS）。

papers.title: Identity-Conditioned Latent Consistency Distillation for Face Synthesis
papers.authors: Tiago Kienen Chaves, Bernardo Biesseck, David Menotti
papers.tags: image generation, diffusion model
papers.affiliations: Federal University of Paraná（UFPR）；Bernardo Biesseck 同时隶属于 Federal Institute of Mato Grosso (IFMT)
papers.intro: 本文通过将Arc2Face扩散模型（教师）蒸馏为潜在一致性模型（学生），在保持图像质量的前提下，将身份条件化人脸生成的推理速度提升4.36倍，实现了大规模合成人脸数据集的高效生成。

papers.title: Segmentation of Bovid Dentition Under Imperfect Annotations: A Comparative Study of Convolutional and Attention Models
papers.authors: Keith G. Mills, Evan B. Sanders, Gregory J. Matthews, Juliet K. Brophy
papers.tags: semantic segmentation, vision transformer
papers.affiliations: LSU ATHENA Lab, Loyola Dept. Math & Stats, LSU Dept. Geography & Anthropology
papers.intro: 本文系统比较了从卷积神经网络到视觉Transformer的多种语义分割架构在标注不完美的B.O.V.I.D.牛科牙齿数据集上的表现，发现预处理技术对定量指标影响有限但对定性结果影响显著，且轻量级CNN编码器（如MobileNetV2）在性能上可与计算量数倍于其的SegFormer相媲美。

papers.title: DARP: A Calibrated Dual-Arm RGB-D-IR Dataset for Multi-View Robotic Perception
papers.authors: Manish Kansana, Mohammed Yusuf Mujawar, Sudip Mittal, Shahram Rahimi, Noorbakhsh Amiri Golilarz
papers.tags: 3D reconstruction, pose estimation, depth estimation, point cloud, autonomous driving
papers.affiliations: Department of Computer Science, The University of Alabama, Tuscaloosa, AL, USA
papers.intro: 本文提出了DARP，一个由两台独立移动的眼在手机械臂采集的校准双RGB-D-IR数据集，通过保留传感器原始记录、机器人关节状态和校准信息，实现了共享度量坐标系下的多视角物体感知与确定性几何融合评估。

papers.title: Multi-View Reflective Surface Inspection via Semantic-Saliency Cross-Verification
papers.authors: Van-Giang Nguyen, Thanh-Tuan Tran, Xuan-Hieu Phan, Xiem HoangVan
papers.tags: object detection, image generation, multimodal learning
papers.affiliations: University of Engineering and Technology, Vietnam National University, Hanoi 10000, Vietnam
papers.intro: 本文提出一种多视角反光表面检测框架，通过视觉语言模型产生的语义框与正常参考重建分支产生的显著性图进行空间交叉验证，在不修改语义坐标的前提下对检测结果进行重排序，并在产品层面无需跨视角配准地聚合多视角证据。

papers.title: Vision Models Predict Urban Scene Appraisal with Limited Neural Alignment
papers.authors: Kaizhen Tan, Yuantao Deng
papers.tags: scene understanding, image classification, CLIP
papers.affiliations: New York University
papers.intro: 该论文通过EEG数据系统评估了十七种视觉表征与人类城市场景神经几何的对应关系，发现当前视觉模型虽然能很好地预测人类评价（r=0.87），但与神经表征的对应度普遍较低（最高仅达噪声下限的29.6%），且预测能力与神经对齐度不相关。

papers.title: LOCI: A Locator-Critic with Refinement Loop
papers.authors: Walid Bousselham, Mathilde Caron, Arsha Nagrani, Cordelia Schmid
papers.tags: multimodal learning, visual question answering, visual grounding
papers.affiliations: Google DeepMind
papers.intro: LOCI提出了一种无需训练的Locator-Critic多智能体框架，通过将视觉证据搜索与证据验证解耦，并利用迭代精化循环，显著提升了VLM在复杂视觉问答基准上的性能。

papers.title: Failure or Drift? Evaluating Monocular SLAM under Synthetic and Real-World Corruptions
papers.authors: Abhay Skaria Thomas, Shashank Agnihotri, Margret Keuper
papers.tags: 3D reconstruction, autonomous driving, scene understanding, depth estimation
papers.affiliations: University of Mannheim, Germany; Max-Planck-Institute for Informatics, Saarland Informatics Campus, Germany
papers.intro: 本文通过对比ORB-SLAM2、DPVO和DROID-SLAM在图像空间、几何感知和复合退化以及4Seasons真实恶劣条件下的表现，揭示了合成退化的物理保真度会改变学习型跟踪器的相对排序，并提出了区分显式跟踪失败与隐式漂移的失败感知评估协议。

papers.title: CANVAS: Consistency-Aware Navigation via Visual Adaptive Sampling for Long-Context Text-to-SVG Generation
papers.authors: Yichen Wu, Haoxuan Qu, Yihang Lou, Hossein Rahmani, Jun Liu
papers.tags: image generation
papers.affiliations: University of Nottingham, Lancaster University, Peking University
papers.intro: CANVAS是一个无需训练、渲染感知的推理框架，通过将功率锐化的轨迹似然与渲染未来的视觉反馈相结合，推导出笔画级导航规则，在有限生成和渲染预算下自适应分配采样资源，从而提升长上下文Text-to-SVG生成的全局一致性。

papers.title: Quanta Perception as Probabilistic Events
papers.authors: Varun Sundar, Pavan Thodima, Sacha Jungerman, Mohit Gupta
papers.tags: pose estimation, object detection, image generation
papers.affiliations: Department of Computer Sciences, University of Wisconsin–Madison, Wisconsin, United States
papers.intro: 本文提出"概率事件"（probabilistic events）这一计算原语，通过递归贝叶斯推断直接在光子流上进行实时量子感知，将光子流表示为关于强度变化时间的后验信念状态，从而在无需重建强度帧的情况下实现低延迟、高吞吐的极端环境感知。

papers.title: WikiSkill: Compiling Agent Experience into Persistent Knowledge for Skill Evolution
papers.authors: Liyan Tang, Cyrus Rashtchian, Chun-Sung Ferng, Andrew Tomkins, Da-Cheng Juan, Tu Vu
papers.tags: multimodal learning, vision transformer, scene understanding
papers.affiliations: Google Research, Virginia Tech
papers.intro: WikiSkill提出了一种将智能体原始执行经验编译为持久化知识库（wiki），并与可执行技能协同演化的框架，通过三层知识架构（原始轨迹层、知识层、技能层）和四组件演化循环，显著提升了技能演化的效果和跨模型迁移能力。

papers.title: Retrieval Heads Meet Vision: Uncovering How VLMs Locate and Extract Visual Information
papers.authors: Chanho Park, Daehyeon Choi, Jihyun Lee, Minhyuk Sung
papers.tags: multimodal learning, visual grounding, vision transformer
papers.affiliations: KAIST（Chanho Park, Daehyeon Choi, Minhyuk Sung）；Independent Researcher（Jihyun Lee）
papers.intro: 本文首次在视觉语言模型中发现并验证了一类稀疏的、因果必要的注意力头——视觉检索头（Visual Retrieval Heads, VRHs），它们负责将文本描述与图像区域进行关联，并展现出跨任务泛化、功能特异性和跨架构可迁移等新特性。

papers.title: CLAP: Cross-Embodiment Video World Models are Zero-Shot Physical Simulators
papers.authors: Kechen Liu, Ola Shorinwa
papers.tags: video generation, diffusion model, multimodal learning
papers.affiliations: Princeton University
papers.intro: CLAP提出了一种跨形态行动条件视频世界模型训练框架，通过统一端效应器动作、语言动作和潜在动作三种动作表示，并采用课程式学习策略，使视频模型能够从人类和多种机器人形态的异构视频数据中学习通用物理先验，实现零样本部署到真实世界任务。

papers.title: LeVJEPA: Efficient & Scalable Video Pretraining without the Heuristics
papers.authors: Lukas Kuhn, Lucas Maes, Giuseppe Serra, Quentin Le Lidec, Yann LeCun, Randall Balestriero, Florian Buettner
papers.tags: video segmentation, vision transformer, video generation, multimodal learning
papers.affiliations: German Cancer Research Center, German Cancer Consortium, Goethe University Frankfurt, Mila, Université de Montréal, Brown University, Courant Institute New York University, Advanced Machine Intelligence (AMI Labs)
papers.intro: LeVJEPA是首个在LeJEPA无坍塌目标下训练的视频编码器，通过SIGReg正则化以单一编码器和单一损失实现高效视频预训练，在匹配总FLOPs下超越最强视频基线7.6个ImageNet-1K精度点，同时将预训练计算成本降低5.6至20.8倍。

papers.title: Successive Capacity Growth: Task-Complexity-Driven Width and Depth Expansion for Vision Transformer Encoders in JEPA World Models
papers.authors: Frederik Berenz
papers.tags: vision transformer, image generation
papers.affiliations: 121-labs.com, Remscheid, Germany
papers.intro: 本文提出Successive Capacity Growth (SCG)方法，通过任务无关的测试-验证机制驱动ViT编码器在宽度（增加注意力头）和深度（增加Transformer块）上函数保持地渐进增长，使JEPA世界模型编码器从最小配置开始按任务复杂度自适应扩展，在保持位精确函数保持的同时实现显著…

papers.title: PAWBench: How Far Are We from Probabilistically Aligned World Modeling?
papers.authors: Yuandong Pu, Le Zhuo, Sayak Paul, Gabriel Jorge Menezes, Avram Đorđević, Shiyang Li, Yifan Zhou, Bin Fu, Wenlong Zhang, Junjun He, Yu Qiao, Yihao Liu, Jingbo Xing, Xi Chen
papers.tags: video generation, diffusion model, scene understanding
papers.affiliations: Shanghai Jiao Tong University, Shanghai AI Laboratory, Krea AI, Huggingface, Shanghai Innovation Institute, Tongyi Lab, The University of Hong Kong
papers.intro: 本文提出PAWBench基准和PAWEval评估协议，通过重复rollout将视频生成模型视为随机采样器，系统评估其在固定初始观测和动作下是否实现概率对齐的世界建模，并揭示当前11个视频生成系统均未达到该标准。

papers.title: Comparative Evaluation of 3D Reconstruction Methods for Immersive Visualization of Laboratory Objects
papers.authors: Brian De La Cruz, Aaron Y. Zhao, Maitrey Gramopadhye, Sawyer J. Lazar, Xianming Tan, Daniel Szafir, David S. Lawrence
papers.tags: 3D reconstruction, NeRF, point cloud, LiDAR, autonomous driving
papers.affiliations: The University of North Carolina, Chapel Hill
papers.intro: 本研究通过对比摄影测量、NeRF、高斯泼溅和LiDAR四种3D重建方法在创建实验室物品全息模型时的保真度，发现NeRF方法在透明、反射和低纹理物体上表现最为一致且高质量，并验证了3D重建用于AR/MR教育环境的可行工作流程。
